ocr.notes: Minor errors in the headline ('Wetkins') and stray characters at top.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic reported that Fred Watkins, a noted sporting man in the leather business, died at his room in St. Louis on Friday evening. He had backed Tom Allen in many of his big fights.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic, St. Louis, Sunday Morning, May 3, 1896, page 10.

facts.fact: Fred Watkins, St. Louis sporting man and leather merchant who backed Allen in many of his big fights, died in St. Louis

notes: Died 'Friday evening'; the paper is Sunday May 3, 1896, so May 1. Same event as 929.
